title: ESP32 + OLED tabletop assembly
description: Connect a compatible I2C OLED to an ESP32 with power disconnected.
safetyNotice: Keep power disconnected while wiring. Check labels on the actual hardware before every connection.

components.name: I2C OLED module
components.description: OLED module compatible with 3.3V logic and supply.
components.notes: Confirm the module pin labels and voltage rating.

workspace.calibrationInstructions: Calibrate the four corners of the physical tabletop before following overlays.
workspace.movementWarning: Recalibrate after either board or the camera moves; calibration is not proof of wiring.

steps.title: Prepare with power off
steps.instruction: Disconnect USB and any external power. Confirm the OLED is compatible with 3.3V.
steps.expectedState: Both boards are unpowered and pin labels are readable.
steps.failureRecovery: Disconnect power and re-check the module documentation.

steps.title: Connect GND to GND
steps.instruction: Connect ESP32 GND to OLED GND.
steps.expectedState: A ground wire joins the labelled GND pins.
steps.failureRecovery: Remove the wire and check both physical GND labels.

steps.title: Connect 3.3V to VCC
steps.warning: Use 3.3V only after checking OLED compatibility.
steps.failureRecovery: Remove the wire and check the OLED voltage requirement.

steps.title: Connect GPIO21 to SDA
steps.failureRecovery: Re-check the physical GPIO21 and SDA labels.

steps.title: Connect GPIO22 to SCL
steps.failureRecovery: Re-check the physical GPIO22 and SCL labels.

steps.title: Final visual review
steps.instruction: With power still disconnected, visually review every labelled connection.
steps.warning: This review version does not electrically verify connections.
steps.expectedState: Each wire has been visually checked against actual hardware labels.
steps.failureRecovery: Return to the affected connection and re-check labels.
